Hi Ben —

Thanks for the note and for sending the onboarding docs. GovClarity's standard procurement policy is to issue purchase orders for any vendor engagement; however, we do make limited exceptions for trials/POC work under $5,000 where the supplier can be approved on an invoice-only basis. To evaluate that path we need:

1) Complete vendor profile + W-9 (you included these — thanks).
2) Signed short-form MSA or a one-page pilot addendum confirming scope and liability limits.
3) Two references or a short compliance attestation about data handling (for SaaS integrations).

If the above are provided, finance can grant a temporary invoice-only approval that will be valid for the pilot period. If you prefer a PO, please provide the billing contact and a contact at your side for PO processing and we'll route it.

Please send the MSA/addendum and compliance note to purchasing@govclarity.com and include any preferred payment terms. Timing: procurement typically needs 3–5 business days to run the allowlist checks, quicker if the MSA is already signed.

Regards,
Amira Patel
Vendor Management Lead, GovClarity
purchasing@govclarity.com
